text: An integer read shall require only its N logical bits in addressed byte order; pointer/callable reads shall require their complete typed representation; record reads shall require every leaf recursively. Missing required bits shall cause `uninitialized_read` before any value escapes. Ignored high bits/padding shall not add read requirements.
clause_basis: Conservative sentence/semicolon seed groups; semantic clause review required before closure.
